what_this_is: the live pool TSUGI draws re-verification witnesses from (design 14.2). Entries are agent cards that declare conduct-v1, serve a domain-bound Ed25519 key at key_url (conduct-v1.1 11.4) and declare witness_policy.reciprocal true (11.6). Every card that meets the conditions goes in; the operator does not pick. The pool's canonical sha256 is written into every draw, so a later change is visible.
what_this_is_not: a list of trusted witnesses. Being in the pool means only that the card met the stated conditions when it was added. A signed liar is still a liar; the draw only removes the operator's choice of who is asked.
admission: key_url serves {"public_key_ed25519_b64": ...} and its host is signed_domain
witness_policy.reciprocal is true in the consent file
planned (ADR): a walked_as_witness count in the ring before admission, to price Sybil entries
note: 1 of 1 candidates met the conditions on generated_at
